skip_reason: Services offline (backend/frontend not reachable at audit time)

findings.title: Route handlers access store directly — service layer bypassed
findings.detail: CLAUDE.md mandates no direct DB calls from route handlers. Three of four routes bypass the service layer entirely with 18 combined direct store calls. Only dashboard.ts follows the rule. Routes are non-unit-testable in isolation.
findings.recommendation: Create workItemService.ts and intakeService.ts; move all store.* calls there; have routes call services only.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer only validates 1 of 8 plans; misses lowercase FR IDs
findings.detail: Enforcer uses max(req_files, key=os.path.getmtime) — checks only the most recently modified requirements.md. 7 plans (125 FRs) are never verified. Regex FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ silently drops all lowercase descriptive IDs like FR-dependency-types.
findings.recommendation: Add --all flag to iterate all Plans/*/requirements.md; fix regex to FR-[A-Za-z0-9-]+.

findings.title: protobufjs code injection in orchestrator (GHSA-66ff-xgx4-vchm)
findings.detail: CWE-94 code injection via crafted protobuf messages. Affects protobufjs <=7.5.5. Arbitrary code execution in orchestrator — the agent pipeline infrastructure.

findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js — Server crash + certificate auth bypass in orchestrator
findings.detail: Three HIGH CVEs: malformed requests crash the gRPC server (CVSS 7.5×2), getAuthContext returns unauthorized certificates as authorized (CVSS 7.4). Orchestrator can be crashed or its auth bypassed.

findings.title: 7 plans (106+ FRs) have zero Verifies: comments in source
findings.detail: Features ARE implemented but carry no traceability links. The spec-first principle is structurally violated for all plans except self-judging-workflow.
findings.recommendation: Backfill // Verifies: FR-XXX comments in source files for each plan after fixing QO-002.

findings.title: 4 frontend components have no test files
findings.detail: Badge components render different visual states based on enum values — regressions in display logic go undetected. Layout renders navigation shell.
findings.recommendation: Create test files for all four components with // Verifies: comments linking to relevant FRs.

findings.title: FR ID naming fragmented across 3 incompatible conventions
findings.detail: Three formats: FR-NNN (legacy numeric), FR-lowercase-descriptive (dependency-linking), FR-WF-NNN (namespace-prefixed). Enforcer silently skips lowercase IDs.
findings.recommendation: Standardize to FR-{NAMESPACE}-{NNN}. Update enforcer regex.

findings.title: body-parser DoS via trailing bytes in compressed requests
findings.detail: body-parser <1.20.9 crashes on compressed request bodies with trailing bytes. CVSS 7.5. Network accessible, no auth required.
findings.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update express; cd platform/orchestrator && npm update express

findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS in orchestrator URL routing
findings.detail: ReDoS via multiple route parameters. Affects path-to-regexp <0.1.13. Orchestrator crashable via crafted URLs.

findings.title: @remix-run/router open redirect via protocol-relative URL
findings.detail: CWE-601: same-origin redirect with path starting // causes browser to interpret as protocol-relative external URL. Affects @remix-run/router 1.3.0–1.23.2 (via react-router-dom).

findings.title: pino logger 2 major versions behind (8.17.0 vs 10.4.0)
findings.detail: Pino is the security-critical logging layer. 2 major versions behind indicates likely missing security patches and performance improvements.

findings.title: 2 eslint-disable suppressions without rationale comments
findings.detail: Both suppress react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without explanation. DependencyPicker suppression may cause stale closure bugs.
findings.recommendation: Add inline explanation or refactor to eliminate suppression need.

findings.title: browserslist — unbounded memory growth DoS (GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx)
form-data — CRLF injection in multipart field names
postcss — arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL path traversal
nanoid — infinite loops and integer overflow (ID collision risk)
uuid 5 major versions behind (9.0.0 vs 14.0.3) in Backend
brace-expansion — 5 DoS CVEs (exponential expansion, OOM, recursion)
React ecosystem 1 major version behind (18.x vs 19.x)
findings.detail: react, react-dom, react-router-dom all 1 major behind. react-router-dom already has open CVE (DEP-005).
findings.fix: Plan major version upgrade cycle: npm install react@19 react-dom@19 react-router-dom@7

findings.title: Orchestrator direct dependencies all 1 major version behind
findings.detail: dockerode 4→5, express 4→5, multer 1→2. Express already has CVEs (DEP-003, DEP-004).
findings.fix: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update express dockerode multer
